front: Why do Russian 1917 dates differ by 13 days?
back: Russia used the Julian calendar until February 1918; the West used the Gregorian.
The temporary government formed from Duma members after the Tsar's abdication, led by Lvov and then Kerensky.
The sharing of authority between the Provisional Government and the Petrograd Soviet in 1917.
Lenin's demands of April 1917: no support for the government, end the war, all power to the soviets.
An apparent advance on Petrograd by General Kornilov (September 1917); Kerensky armed the Red Guards to stop it.

front: When did the Bolsheviks seize power?
What was Trotsky's role in November 1917?
back: Chairman of the Petrograd Soviet; he organised the rising through the Military Revolutionary Committee.

front: Why did the Provisional Government fail?
back: It continued the war, delayed land reform and elections, shared power with the Soviet and was weakened by the Kornilov affair.
